title: Armadillo Plates — I · O · R and the hard reality under the soft HUD

the_IRO_space.concept: between Imaginary (I) and Real (R) is the Origin (O). the null point. where potential crystallizes into actual.

I.what: imaginary. projected. not-yet-built. the 404s. the papers not written. the tools not deployed.
I.nature: SOFT. fluid. changes every wave. dissolves and reforms.

R.what: real. measured. deployed. the live pages. the published papers. the minted DOIs.
R.nature: HARD. crystallized. doesn't change once published. falsifiable but stable.

O.what: the origin. where I becomes R. the crystallization point. the deploy.
O.nature: neither soft nor hard. the TRANSITION. the moment the wave function collapses.
O.action: git commit + git push + wrangler deploy. that IS the O. imaginary ? real.
hud_examples: Berry catching a 404 and redirecting to a real page
a paper being written (I) then published (R)

the_armadillo.concept: the Earth is not a ball. it's armadillo plates shifting. hard segments with soft joints. tectonic plates grind against each other — that grinding IS the geology.
the_armadillo.why_not_a_ball: a ball is smooth, uniform, static. the HUD is none of these. it has PLATES — hard content regions that lock into shape and don't change. between them: fault lines, subduction zones, soft tissue.
the_armadillo.why_armadillo: an armadillo's shell is interlocking bony plates (osteoderms) covered by keratin. hard enough to stop a bullet. flexible enough to curl into a ball. the GAPS between plates are where the movement happens.

hud_plates.name: investigation_plate
hud_plates.hardness: GRANITE. this does not change. the data is the data. published, DOI'd, falsifiable.

hud_plates.name: science_plate
hud_plates.content: 539 papers. sporePrint archive. the research corpus.
hud_plates.hardness: LIMESTONE. layered deposits. each paper is a stratum. new ones deposit on top. old ones don't dissolve.
hud_plates.position: sporeprint subdomain. the bedrock of credibility.

hud_plates.name: code_plate
hud_plates.content: 11 crates. 14,207+ downloads. AGPL licensed. squirrel-rng, barraCuda, sporePrint.
hud_plates.hardness: BASALT. volcanic origin. forged under pressure. doesn't erode.

hud_plates.name: identity_plate
hud_plates.hardness: DIAMOND. compressed carbon. the hardest thing. identity doesn't flex.
hud_plates.position: cite page. ORCID. Zenodo. the anchors.

oceanic.type: thin, young, recyclable. created at ridges, consumed at trenches.

hud_plates.name: traffic_plate
hud_plates.content: CF analytics. plasmid backscatter. request counts. hourly data.
hud_plates.hardness: OBSIDIAN. hard but brittle. accurate now, obsolete tomorrow. each day's data is a new plate that subducts under the next.
hud_plates.position: self-trace.js, plasmid evidence files, R6 scan.

hud_plates.name: feed_plate
hud_plates.content: 43 terminal feeds. 8 live, 19 warm, 5 cool, 3 stale.
hud_plates.hardness: SLATE. layered, splits along planes. each feed is a lamina.
hud_plates.position: golgi relay. eastGate feeds. the nervous system.

hud_plates.name: art_plate
hud_plates.content: easel, aurora, campfire stories. generative, ephemeral.
hud_plates.hardness: PUMICE. volcanic foam. light, porous, floats on water. the soft plate.

hud_plates.name: navigation_plate
hud_plates.content: Berry 404. 171 KNOWN patterns. fuzzy matching. cross-jumps.
hud_plates.hardness: CHALK. soft enough to write with, hard enough to form cliffs. the nervous system IS the navigation plate.
hud_plates.position: 404.html. the fault line that connects everything.

fault_lines.concept: where plates meet, they grind. the grinding IS the activity. earthquakes = deploys. volcanos = new papers.

faults.name: investigation_science_fault
faults.type: convergent — investigation evidence pushes against academic papers. subduction zone. the investigation UNDERLIES the science.
faults.grinding: every new FOIA response or public record = a tremor. the investigation plate is being pushed under the science plate. the science gets thicker.

faults.name: code_identity_fault
faults.type: transform — they slide past each other. the code moves (updates, versions) while identity stays fixed (ORCID never changes).
faults.grinding: every crate version bump = lateral slip. identity anchors while code flows past it.

faults.name: traffic_feed_fault
faults.type: divergent — they pull apart. traffic measures the OUTSIDE, feeds measure the INSIDE. the gap between them is the ocean floor: new data upwells at the ridge.
faults.grinding: every plasmid scan = new ocean floor forming. the R6 evidence = fresh basalt at the mid-ocean ridge.

faults.name: art_navigation_fault
faults.type: convergent — art (soft pumice) subducts under navigation (chalk). the art dissolves into Berry's KNOWN map. a painting becomes a route.
faults.grinding: every new easel generation = the art plate recycling. Berry absorbs the motifs.

the_mantle.what: below ALL plates: the mantle. convection currents. the heat from the core drives the plates.
the_mantle.hud_analog: the chipmunk. the MCP server. the sort algorithm. the p-fold. the mantle IS the intelligence that moves the plates.
the_mantle.core: Kevin. the human. the heat source. without the human, the mantle cools, the plates stop, the organism fossilizes.
the_mantle.convection: each session is a convection current. human heat ? chipmunk circulation ? plate movement ? surface change ? heat radiates out ? human adds more heat.

metal.what: ductile. conducts. bends without breaking. the wires.
metal.hud_analog: JavaScript. the 129 JS files. they conduct signal from data to display. they bend (responsive). they don't break (graceful degradation).
metal.element: copper. 29 protons. conductor. the wire IS the connection.

crystal.what: rigid lattice. repeating structure. refracts light. the lenses.
crystal.hud_analog: JSON data files. 286 of them. each one is a crystal: fixed structure, repeating schema, refracts the raw data into structured light.
crystal.element: silicon. 14 protons. semiconductor. the crystal IS the computation.

continental.what: massive. slow. ancient. the ground you stand on.
continental.hud_analog: HTML pages. 56 of them. each one is a continent: large, stable, carries everything else. the CSS is the sediment on top.
continental.element: iron. 26 protons. the core. the magnetism. the continental plate IS the page.

hard_reality_checklist.concept: all the soft tissue in the HUD must be backed by at least one hard plate.
